# Support

Ways to get help with `@inandu-solutions/grid-angular`:

- **Questions and usage help** — [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid/discussions)
- **Bug reports and feature requests** — [open an issue](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid/issues/new/choose)
- **User manual** — <https://inandusolutions.github.io/inandu-grid/manual.html>
- **Live demo and examples** — <https://inandusolutions.github.io/inandu-grid/>
- **Security reports** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); please don't open a public issue

For commercial support and the `@inandu-solutions/grid-pro` add-ons, see <https://www.inandu.com>.
